name: - NUM
fix_description: In anySwapOutUnderlyingWithPermit, validate that the token parameter is a legitimate registered AnyswapV1ERC20 token (whitelist check). Currently any address can be passed as token, allowing attackers to use a fake token contract whose underlying() returns a target token, then steal funds from users who have permit signatures or existing approvals.
difficulty_reasoning: This is a very simple two-step exploit: set an arbitrary marketing wallet and then call rescueEth to drain funds. It matches an obvious access control flaw, requires no DeFi-specific knowledge, and the PoC is short with only a couple of external calls.
